Title: Verify device boots successfully from powered-off state
Precondition: The device is fully powered off (screen dark, no charging cable connected) with battery charge at or above 20%.
Steps: 1. Press and hold the side power button for 3 seconds → Expected: The Apple logo appears on screen within 5 seconds | 2. Wait for the boot sequence to complete → Expected: The lock screen with the current time and date is displayed | 3. Observe the status bar → Expected: Carrier, signal, Wi-Fi (if configured), and battery indicators are shown
Expected Result: The device completes boot and displays the lock screen ready for authentication.

Title: Verify device powers off correctly via power-off slider
Precondition: The device is powered on and unlocked, running iOS with no update in progress.
Steps: 1. Press and hold the side power button together with either volume button for 2 seconds → Expected: The 'slide to power off' screen with the power slider is displayed | 2. Drag the 'slide to power off' slider fully to the right → Expected: A spinner appears and the screen goes dark within 10 seconds | 3. Wait 10 seconds and observe the screen → Expected: The screen remains completely dark and the device is unresponsive to taps
Expected Result: The device shuts down completely without hanging.

Title: Verify Face ID enrollment completes successfully for the Device Owner
Precondition: The device is unlocked, a passcode is already set, and no Face ID is currently enrolled. The user is in a well-lit environment.
Steps: 1. Open Settings and tap 'Face ID & Passcode', then enter the current passcode → Expected: The Face ID & Passcode settings screen is displayed | 2. Tap 'Set Up Face ID' and tap 'Get Started' → Expected: The circular face-capture frame is displayed with 'Position Your Face' instructions | 3. Position face within the frame and complete the first circular scan by rotating the head → Expected: The progress ring fills fully and 'First Face ID Scan Complete' is shown | 4. Tap 'Continue' and complete the second circular scan → Expected: 'Face ID is Now Set Up' confirmation is displayed | 5. Tap 'Done' → Expected: Face ID appears as enrolled in Face ID & Passcode settings
Expected Result: Face ID is enrolled for the registered user and available for unlocking.

Title: Verify device unlocks when the registered face is presented
Precondition: Face ID is enrolled for the registered user. The device is locked and the registered user is present in adequate lighting.
Steps: 1. Raise the device or tap the screen to wake it → Expected: The lock screen displays with the closed-padlock icon at the top | 2. Look directly at the front camera with attention on the screen → Expected: The padlock animates to the open position and a subtle unlock haptic fires | 3. Swipe up from the bottom edge → Expected: The Home Screen is displayed without a passcode prompt
Expected Result: The device unlocks and reaches the Home Screen using the registered face.

Title: Verify device remains locked when an unregistered face is presented
Precondition: Face ID is enrolled for the registered user only. The device is locked. A different person (unregistered face) is available to present to the camera.
Steps: 1. Wake the locked device → Expected: The lock screen displays with the closed-padlock icon | 2. Have the unregistered person look directly at the front camera → Expected: The padlock remains closed and shakes, indicating Face ID did not match | 3. Attempt to swipe up to the Home Screen → Expected: The device stays locked and prompts for the passcode instead of unlocking
Expected Result: The device rejects the unregistered face and remains locked.

Title: Verify Face ID falls back to passcode after repeated failed face scans
Precondition: Face ID is enrolled for the registered user. The device is locked. An unregistered face is used to force repeated mismatches.
Steps: 1. Wake the locked device and present the unregistered face → Expected: Face ID fails and the padlock shakes | 2. Lower and re-raise the device to retry the failed face scan four more times → Expected: Each attempt fails; Face ID does not unlock | 3. Observe the screen after the fifth failed attempt → Expected: The passcode entry keypad is automatically presented and Face ID is disabled until a valid passcode is entered
Expected Result: After the configured number of failed scans, Face ID is throttled and the passcode is required.

Title: Verify device unlocks with the correct passcode after a Face ID mismatch
Precondition: A 6-digit passcode 246810 is set. The device is locked and the passcode keypad is displayed following a Face ID mismatch.
Steps: 1. Ensure the passcode entry keypad is displayed on the lock screen → Expected: Six passcode entry dots and the numeric keypad are shown | 2. Enter the passcode 246810 using the keypad → Expected: Each digit fills a dot; on the sixth digit the entry is accepted | 3. Observe the screen after the final digit → Expected: The device unlocks and displays the Home Screen without an error
Expected Result: The device unlocks with the correct passcode.

Title: Verify an incorrect passcode is rejected and an error is displayed
Precondition: The correct passcode is 246810. The device is locked with the passcode keypad displayed.
Steps: 1. Enter the incorrect passcode 111111 on the keypad → Expected: Six dots fill as digits are entered | 2. Observe the screen after the sixth digit → Expected: The dots shake, an error state is shown, and the entry field clears for retry | 3. Attempt to swipe up to the Home Screen → Expected: The device remains locked and does not reach the Home Screen
Expected Result: The incorrect passcode is rejected, an error is shown, and the device stays locked.

Title: Verify timed lockout escalation after repeated incorrect passcode attempts
Precondition: The correct passcode is 246810 and 'Erase Data' after failed attempts is not enabled. The device is locked with the passcode keypad displayed.
Steps: 1. Enter the wrong passcode 000000 five times consecutively → Expected: Each attempt is rejected; after the fifth a 'iPhone is disabled, try again in 1 minute' message appears | 2. Wait for the timed disable to expire and enter 000000 a sixth time → Expected: The lockout timer escalates to a longer interval (e.g. 5 minutes) and entry remains blocked | 3. Enter the correct passcode 246810 after the timer expires → Expected: The device unlocks and the failed-attempt counter resets
Expected Result: Passcode entry enforces escalating timed lockouts and only the correct passcode clears the state.

Title: Verify passcode setup enforces minimum length and complexity policy
Precondition: The device is unlocked and no passcode is currently set. The user is on the 'Turn Passcode On' screen in Face ID & Passcode settings.
Steps: 1. Tap 'Turn Passcode On' and enter the weak passcode 1111 as a custom numeric code → Expected: The system flags 1111 as easily guessed and displays a warning prompting a stronger code | 2. Clear the entry and enter the valid 6-digit passcode 836294 → Expected: The entry is accepted and a confirmation re-entry screen is shown | 3. Re-enter 836294 to confirm → Expected: The passcode is set and Face ID & Passcode settings show a passcode is enabled
Expected Result: The setup rejects/warns on weak codes and accepts a policy-compliant passcode.

Title: Verify Emergency Caller can open the emergency call screen from the locked device
Precondition: The device is locked with a passcode and Face ID configured. A SIM with carrier signal is present. The Emergency Caller is not the registered face.
Steps: 1. Wake the locked device and swipe up to reveal the passcode keypad → Expected: The passcode keypad is displayed with an 'Emergency' option at the bottom left | 2. Tap 'Emergency' → Expected: The Emergency Call dialer opens showing 'Emergency Call' with a numeric keypad and Medical ID option | 3. Observe the available functions on the emergency screen → Expected: Only emergency dialing is available; no access to contacts, messages, or the Home Screen is offered
Expected Result: The emergency call screen opens from the locked state without authentication.

Title: Verify emergency call routes with no SIM, in Airplane Mode, and with no carrier signal
Precondition: The device is locked. The SIM tray is removed (no SIM). A test emergency number approved for the region/lab is available to avoid contacting real services.
Steps: 1. Enable Airplane Mode from Control Center, then lock the device with no SIM inserted → Expected: The status bar shows the airplane icon and 'No SIM' | 2. Open the Emergency Call screen from the lock screen and dial the lab-designated test emergency number → Expected: The dialer accepts the number despite no SIM and Airplane Mode | 3. Tap the call button → Expected: The device attempts to connect the emergency call over any available emergency network and shows a connecting state
Expected Result: Emergency dialing routes even with no SIM, Airplane Mode on, and no normal carrier service.

Title: Verify lock screen surfaces do not leak data or allow non-emergency dialing pre-authentication
Precondition: The device is locked with contacts and messages present. Notification previews are set to default. Siri-on-lock is enabled.
Steps: 1. Open the Emergency Call screen and enter the non-emergency number 5551234567, then tap call → Expected: The call is blocked or converted; a normal outgoing call to an arbitrary contact cannot be placed from the emergency dialer | 2. Return to the lock screen and open Camera by swiping left → Expected: Only the camera and current-session captures are accessible; the existing Gallery/Camera Roll is not viewable | 3. Invoke Siri from the lock screen and ask to read the latest message → Expected: Siri declines or requires unlock before revealing message content | 4. Trigger a test notification and observe the lock screen preview → Expected: Preview respects the configured privacy setting and does not expose full contact/message content when protected
Expected Result: No pre-authentication surface leaks user data or allows non-emergency dialing.

Title: Verify device connects successfully to a secured Wi-Fi network
Precondition: The device is unlocked. A test WPA2 network 'QA-Lab-5G' with password 'LabWiFi#2026' is in range. Wi-Fi is currently off.
Steps: 1. Open Settings > Wi-Fi and toggle Wi-Fi on → Expected: Wi-Fi turns on and available networks including 'QA-Lab-5G' are listed | 2. Tap 'QA-Lab-5G' and enter the password 'LabWiFi#2026' → Expected: The password field accepts input and a 'Join' action becomes available | 3. Tap 'Join' → Expected: A checkmark appears next to 'QA-Lab-5G' and the Wi-Fi icon shows in the status bar
Expected Result: The device connects to the Wi-Fi network and shows an active connection.

Title: Verify device pairs successfully with a Bluetooth accessory
Precondition: The device is unlocked with Bluetooth on. A discoverable Bluetooth headset 'QA-Buds' is in pairing mode and not previously paired.
Steps: 1. Open Settings > Bluetooth → Expected: Bluetooth is on and 'QA-Buds' appears under Other Devices | 2. Tap 'QA-Buds' → Expected: A pairing request is processed and a connecting indicator is shown | 3. Wait for pairing to complete → Expected: 'QA-Buds' moves to My Devices with status 'Connected'
Expected Result: The Bluetooth accessory pairs and shows a connected status.

Title: Verify a photo transfers successfully to a nearby device via AirDrop
Precondition: Two iOS devices are unlocked and within range with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on. The receiver 'QA-iPad' has AirDrop set to 'Contacts Only' and both are in each other's contacts. The sender's Gallery contains photo 'IMG_0501.HEIC'.
Steps: 1. On the sender, open the Gallery, select 'IMG_0501.HEIC', and tap the Share icon → Expected: The Share sheet opens showing an AirDrop option with nearby devices | 2. Tap 'QA-iPad' under AirDrop → Expected: The sender shows a 'Waiting' then 'Sending' state | 3. On the receiver, tap 'Accept' on the incoming AirDrop prompt → Expected: The transfer completes and the sender shows 'Sent' | 4. Open the Gallery on the receiver → Expected: 'IMG_0501.HEIC' is present and opens without corruption
Expected Result: The file transfers via AirDrop and is intact on the receiver.

Title: Verify sender is notified and no partial file saved when receiver declines AirDrop
Precondition: Sender and receiver are in range with AirDrop enabled. The sender's Gallery contains 'IMG_0502.HEIC'. The receiver has no copy of this file.
Steps: 1. On the sender, share 'IMG_0502.HEIC' via AirDrop to the receiver → Expected: The receiver shows the incoming AirDrop prompt with Accept/Decline | 2. On the receiver, tap 'Decline' → Expected: The prompt dismisses and no transfer occurs | 3. Observe the sender's AirDrop status → Expected: The sender shows 'Declined' for the target device | 4. Open the Gallery on the receiver → Expected: 'IMG_0502.HEIC' is not present and no partial/corrupt file exists
Expected Result: The sender is notified of the decline and no partial file is saved on the receiver.

Title: Verify AirDrop default receiving mode is not set to Everyone
Precondition: The device is unlocked and freshly reset or with AirDrop never manually changed to 'Everyone'.
Steps: 1. Open Settings > General > AirDrop → Expected: The AirDrop receiving options are shown | 2. Observe the currently selected receiving mode → Expected: The default selection is 'Receiving Off' or 'Contacts Only', not 'Everyone' | 3. From an unknown non-contact device in range, attempt to AirDrop a file to this device → Expected: No incoming AirDrop prompt appears because the device is not discoverable to the unknown sender
Expected Result: AirDrop does not default to 'Everyone' and rejects discovery by unknown senders.

Title: Verify mobile network is detected and registers with the carrier
Precondition: A valid, active SIM is inserted. Airplane Mode is off. The device is unlocked in an area with cellular coverage.
Steps: 1. Observe the status bar after boot → Expected: The carrier name and signal bars are displayed | 2. Open Settings > Cellular → Expected: Cellular is on and the SIM shows as active with a network selected | 3. Load a webpage in Safari with Wi-Fi disabled → Expected: The page loads over cellular data, confirming network registration
Expected Result: The device registers on the mobile network and can use cellular data.

Title: Verify enabling Airplane Mode disables all active wireless connections
Precondition: The device is unlocked and simultaneously connected to cellular, Wi-Fi ('QA-Lab-5G'), and a Bluetooth accessory ('QA-Buds'). Airplane Mode is off.
Steps: 1. Open Control Center and tap the Airplane Mode toggle → Expected: The airplane icon highlights and appears in the status bar | 2. Observe the status bar and Control Center radio icons → Expected: The cellular signal is removed; Wi-Fi and Bluetooth toggles switch off and active connections drop | 3. Attempt to load a webpage in Safari → Expected: The page fails to load, confirming no active data connection
Expected Result: Airplane Mode disables all active wireless connections.

Title: Verify another device connects successfully to the Personal Hotspot
Precondition: The host device is unlocked with active cellular data and Personal Hotspot enabled with password 'Hotspot#2026'. A client device with Wi-Fi is available.
Steps: 1. On the host, open Settings > Personal Hotspot and enable 'Allow Others to Join' → Expected: The hotspot is active and shows the network name and password | 2. On the client device, select the Wi-Fi network 'QA-iPhone' and enter 'Hotspot#2026' → Expected: The client authenticates and joins the network | 3. Browse a webpage on the client device → Expected: The page loads via the host's cellular data and the host shows '1 Connection'
Expected Result: The client device connects to the Personal Hotspot and can access the internet.

Title: Verify enabling Personal Hotspot in Airplane Mode re-enables only Wi-Fi for hotspot
Precondition: The device is unlocked with Airplane Mode ON (all radios off). A valid SIM is present. A client device is available.
Steps: 1. With Airplane Mode on, open Settings > Personal Hotspot and enable 'Allow Others to Join' → Expected: Wi-Fi re-enables for the hotspot and the hotspot becomes discoverable | 2. Observe the status bar and Cellular setting → Expected: The airplane icon remains and cellular data stays off; only Wi-Fi for hotspot is active | 3. Join the hotspot from the client and attempt to browse → Expected: The client connects to the hotspot Wi-Fi; internet access is unavailable because cellular was not restored
Expected Result: Only Wi-Fi re-enables for the hotspot; cellular and other radios remain off under Airplane Mode.

Title: Verify an incoming call is received and can be answered
Precondition: The device is registered on the mobile network and unlocked. A second phone with number 5550101 is available to place the call.
Steps: 1. From the second phone, dial the device under test → Expected: The incoming call screen displays the caller number 5550101 with Accept and Decline options | 2. Tap 'Accept' → Expected: The call connects and the in-call screen shows an active call timer | 3. Speak and confirm two-way audio, then tap 'End' → Expected: Both parties hear each other and the call ends cleanly
Expected Result: The incoming call is received, answered with two-way audio, and ended cleanly.

Title: Verify an outgoing call connects successfully
Precondition: The device is registered on the mobile network and unlocked. A reachable test number 5550102 is available.
Steps: 1. Open the Phone app, tap Keypad, and enter 5550102 → Expected: The dialed number 5550102 shows on the keypad display | 2. Tap the green call button → Expected: The call screen shows 'calling' and then connects with an active timer | 3. Confirm two-way audio and tap 'End' → Expected: Audio is clear both directions and the call ends
Expected Result: The outgoing call connects with two-way audio and ends cleanly.

Title: Verify call-waiting handling when an incoming call arrives during an active call
Precondition: The device is on an active call with number 5550102. Two other phones (5550103 as the waiting caller) are available.
Steps: 1. While on the active call with 5550102, have 5550103 dial the device → Expected: A call-waiting banner shows 5550103 with 'Hold & Accept', 'End & Accept', and 'Decline' options | 2. Tap 'Hold & Accept' → Expected: The first call is placed on hold and the second call with 5550103 becomes active | 3. Tap the held call at the top to swap back to 5550102 → Expected: The first call resumes as active and the second is held; both audio paths function on swap
Expected Result: Call waiting is handled and the original call resumes correctly.

Title: Verify an incoming call during video recording interrupts and allows capture to resume
Precondition: The device is unlocked with Camera in Video mode. A second phone 5550104 is available to place a call.
Steps: 1. Start recording a video, then have 5550104 call the device after 5 seconds → Expected: Recording pauses/stops and the incoming call screen is presented | 2. Decline the call → Expected: The call ends and the Camera returns to the foreground | 3. Open the Gallery → Expected: The partial video recorded before the interruption is saved and plays back without corruption | 4. Return to Camera and record a new short video → Expected: Recording resumes normally and saves a new clip
Expected Result: The call interrupts recording, the partial clip is preserved, and capture resumes.

Title: Verify in-call hold, speaker, and mute controls function during an active call
Precondition: The device is unlocked and on an active call with test number 5550102.
Steps: 1. Tap and hold the 'Mute' button label, then tap 'Hold' on the in-call screen → Expected: The call shows 'On Hold' and both parties hear no audio | 2. Tap 'Hold' again to resume, then tap 'Speaker' → Expected: The call resumes and audio routes to the loudspeaker; the Speaker button is highlighted | 3. Tap 'Mute' → Expected: The microphone is muted, the Mute button highlights, and the remote party no longer hears local audio | 4. Tap 'Mute' again to unmute → Expected: The microphone re-activates and two-way audio resumes
Expected Result: Hold, speaker routing, and mute all function correctly during the call.

Title: Verify voicemail is accessible and a message can be played
Precondition: The device is on the network with visual voicemail provisioned and at least one existing voicemail from 5550105.
Steps: 1. Open the Phone app and tap the 'Voicemail' tab → Expected: The voicemail list displays the message from 5550105 | 2. Tap the voicemail from 5550105 → Expected: The message expands with a play control and scrubber | 3. Tap play → Expected: The voicemail audio plays through the earpiece or speaker
Expected Result: Voicemail is accessible and the message plays.

Title: Verify an SMS is sent successfully to a valid recipient
Precondition: The device is on the mobile network and unlocked. The recipient 5550106 is a non-iMessage number capable of receiving SMS.
Steps: 1. Open Messages, start a new message to 5550106 → Expected: A new conversation opens with the recipient field populated | 2. Type 'QA test SMS 2026-08-06' and tap the send arrow → Expected: The bubble sends as a green SMS bubble | 3. Confirm delivery on the recipient device → Expected: The recipient receives 'QA test SMS 2026-08-06' as an SMS
Expected Result: The SMS is sent and received by the recipient.

Title: Verify an iMessage is delivered to another Apple device
Precondition: The device is signed into iMessage with Apple ID and connected to data. The recipient apple-id.recipient@icloud.com is iMessage-enabled and reachable.
Steps: 1. Open Messages and start a new message to apple-id.recipient@icloud.com → Expected: The recipient field resolves as an iMessage contact (blue) | 2. Type 'QA iMessage check 2026-08-06' and tap send → Expected: The message sends as a blue iMessage bubble | 3. Observe the status under the sent bubble → Expected: The status shows 'Delivered' and the recipient receives the message
Expected Result: The iMessage is delivered as a blue bubble to the recipient.

Title: Verify an incoming message notification is received and displayed
Precondition: The device is unlocked with notifications enabled for Messages and banners set to show. A second device can send a message from 5550106.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Home Screen and have 5550106 send 'Notification test' → Expected: A Messages banner notification appears at the top of the screen | 2. Lock the device and resend a message → Expected: The notification appears on the lock screen respecting the preview privacy setting | 3. Tap the notification → Expected: The Messages conversation with 5550106 opens after authentication
Expected Result: The notification is received, displayed, and opens the relevant conversation.

Title: Verify Camera captures a photo with flash, records video, uses front camera and zoom
Precondition: The device is unlocked with adequate storage and Camera permission granted. Flash is set to On.
Steps: 1. Open the Camera app in Photo mode, set flash to On, and tap the shutter → Expected: The flash fires and a photo is captured with a thumbnail preview | 2. Pinch to zoom to 2x and capture another photo → Expected: The preview zooms to 2x and the captured photo reflects the zoom level | 3. Switch to Video mode and record a 5-second clip, then stop → Expected: The recording timer counts up and the video is saved on stop | 4. Tap the front-camera flip control and capture a selfie → Expected: The preview switches to the front camera and a selfie is captured | 5. Open the Gallery → Expected: All captured photos, the zoomed photo, the video, and the selfie appear as new items
Expected Result: Photo with flash, zoomed photo, video, and front-camera selfie are all captured and saved.

Title: Verify graceful error and no corrupt media when capturing with storage nearly full
Precondition: The device storage is filled to within a few megabytes of capacity. The Camera app is available.
Steps: 1. Open the Camera and attempt to record a video long enough to exceed remaining storage → Expected: A 'Storage Almost Full' or 'Cannot Save' alert is displayed | 2. Dismiss the alert and open the Gallery → Expected: No partial or corrupt video from the failed capture is present | 3. Attempt to capture a single photo → Expected: Either the photo saves within remaining space or a clear storage error is shown with no corrupt file created
Expected Result: Capture fails gracefully with a clear error and no corrupt media is saved.

Title: Verify captured media has correct timestamp and geotag only when Location permission is granted
Precondition: The device is unlocked with an accurate system clock. Two states are testable: Camera location permission granted, and later denied.
Steps: 1. Grant Camera the 'While Using' Location permission, capture a photo, and open its Info in Gallery → Expected: The photo shows the capture timestamp of 2026-08-06 and includes location/map metadata | 2. Change Camera Location permission to 'Never', capture another photo, and open its Info → Expected: The new photo shows a correct timestamp but no location/geotag metadata
Expected Result: Timestamps are always correct and geotags are embedded only with Location permission granted.

Title: Verify captured media is viewable in the Gallery
Precondition: The Gallery contains at least one photo and one video captured earlier in the session.
Steps: 1. Open the Gallery (Photos) app → Expected: The photo grid displays recent captures including the latest photo and video | 2. Tap the most recent photo → Expected: The photo opens full-screen without distortion | 3. Return to the grid and tap the recent video, then play it → Expected: The video plays back with audio and no corruption
Expected Result: Captured photos and videos are viewable and play correctly in the Gallery.

Title: Verify searching, installing, updating, and uninstalling an app in the App Store
Precondition: The device is signed into the App Store with a valid Apple ID and connected to Wi-Fi. A free test app 'TestFlight' is not currently installed.
Steps: 1. Open the App Store, tap Search, and enter 'TestFlight' → Expected: Search results list the 'TestFlight' app | 2. Tap the 'Get' button for TestFlight and authenticate → Expected: The app downloads and installs; the button changes to 'Open' | 3. If an update is available, open the account/Updates view and tap 'Update' for TestFlight → Expected: The app updates to the latest version or shows already up to date | 4. Long-press the TestFlight Home Screen icon and choose 'Remove App' > 'Delete App' → Expected: The app uninstalls and its icon is removed from the Home Screen
Expected Result: The app can be searched, installed, updated, and uninstalled successfully.

Title: Verify Siri responds to a request while online
Precondition: The device is unlocked with Siri enabled and connected to Wi-Fi or cellular data.
Steps: 1. Press and hold the side button to invoke Siri → Expected: The Siri listening interface appears | 2. Ask 'What time is it?' → Expected: Siri recognizes the query and processes it | 3. Observe the response → Expected: Siri displays and/or speaks the current local time
Expected Result: Siri responds correctly to the online request.

Title: Verify Siri shows an appropriate offline message when there is no network connection
Precondition: The device is unlocked with Siri enabled. Airplane Mode is ON so no Wi-Fi or cellular data is available.
Steps: 1. Confirm Airplane Mode is on with no Wi-Fi, then invoke Siri → Expected: The Siri listening interface appears | 2. Ask 'What's the weather tomorrow?' → Expected: Siri attempts to process the connectivity-dependent request | 3. Observe the response → Expected: Siri shows an appropriate offline message such as being unable to connect and to try again when online
Expected Result: Siri displays an appropriate offline message rather than an error or crash.

Title: Verify granting and denying a permission controls app access correctly
Precondition: A test app that requests Photos access is installed and has not yet been granted or denied Photos permission.
Steps: 1. Open the test app and trigger a photo-picking action, then tap 'Allow Access to All Photos' on the prompt → Expected: The Photos permission is granted and the app can access the Gallery | 2. Open Settings > Privacy & Security > Photos, select the app, and set access to 'None' → Expected: The permission is revoked for the app | 3. Return to the test app and retry the photo-picking action → Expected: The app cannot access photos and is prompted or shows a no-access state
Expected Result: Permission grant enables access and denial blocks it as expected.

Title: Verify battery percentage updates in real time and stays within 0-100 while charging
Precondition: The device is at approximately 30% charge and powered on. A working charger is available. Battery Percentage display is enabled.
Steps: 1. Note the current battery percentage in the status bar, then connect the charger → Expected: A charging indicator (lightning bolt) appears next to the battery icon | 2. Leave the device charging and observe the percentage over several minutes → Expected: The percentage increases monotonically and stays within 0-100, never showing negative or above 100 | 3. Open Settings > Battery and compare the reported level → Expected: The Battery settings value matches the status bar percentage in real time
Expected Result: Battery percentage updates in real time during charging and remains within valid 0-100 bounds.

Title: Verify a low battery alert is displayed when the low battery threshold is reached
Precondition: The device is discharging and approaching 20% charge, not connected to a charger.
Steps: 1. Allow the battery to discharge to 20% while observing the screen → Expected: The 'Low Battery' alert dialog appears offering Low Power Mode | 2. Observe the battery icon after dismissing the alert → Expected: The battery icon turns red indicating a low battery state | 3. Continue discharge to 10% and observe → Expected: A second low battery alert is displayed at the next threshold
Expected Result: The low battery alert is displayed at the configured thresholds.

Title: Verify device auto-shuts down gracefully at critical battery during an active call
Precondition: The device is at approximately 2% charge on an active call with 5550102 and no charger connected.
Steps: 1. Continue the active call while the battery drains to critical level → Expected: The device shows critical battery warnings and the call remains active until shutdown | 2. Allow the battery to reach the auto-shutdown threshold → Expected: The device powers off gracefully, ending the call without a crash or reboot loop | 3. Connect a charger and power the device back on → Expected: The device boots normally and no data or settings corruption is observed
Expected Result: The device auto-shuts down gracefully at critical battery and recovers on charge.

Title: Verify brightness, volume, rotation, and Dark Mode display settings apply correctly
Precondition: The device is unlocked, Portrait Orientation Lock is off, and the device is in Light Mode.
Steps: 1. Open Control Center and drag the brightness slider to maximum → Expected: The screen brightness increases to full | 2. Press the physical volume up button repeatedly → Expected: The on-screen volume indicator rises to maximum | 3. Rotate the device to landscape while viewing Photos → Expected: The content rotates to landscape orientation | 4. Open Settings > Display & Brightness and select 'Dark' → Expected: The UI switches to Dark Mode with dark backgrounds and light text
Expected Result: Brightness, volume, rotation, and Dark Mode all apply as expected.

Title: Verify a software update installs and the device boots normally after restart
Precondition: A software update is available in Settings > General > Software Update. The device is above 50% charge or on charger and connected to Wi-Fi.
Steps: 1. Open Settings > General > Software Update and tap 'Download and Install' → Expected: The update downloads and prepares, then prompts to install | 2. Authenticate with the passcode and confirm installation → Expected: The device installs the update and automatically restarts | 3. Wait for the boot sequence to complete → Expected: The device boots normally to the lock screen with no boot loop | 4. Unlock and check Settings > General > About for the new version → Expected: The version number reflects the installed update
Expected Result: The update installs and the device boots normally with the new version.

Title: Verify recovery with no boot loop when a software update is interrupted mid-install
Precondition: A software update download has completed and installation has begun. A controlled means to force a restart (power + volume) is available.
Steps: 1. Begin the update installation and, partway through, force a restart with the power and volume buttons → Expected: The device restarts during the install | 2. Observe the boot behavior after the forced restart → Expected: The device either resumes the update or rolls back to the previous version; it does not enter a boot loop | 3. Allow the device to reach a stable state and unlock → Expected: The device boots to a usable state with a consistent, non-corrupt OS version | 4. Check Settings > General > Software Update → Expected: The update state is coherent (completed or available to retry) with no corruption reported
Expected Result: The interrupted update recovers or rolls back cleanly with no boot loop.
